- No broad anti-discrimination protections
- Bail denied because "public is angry" - sentenced to "protect society"
- Community visibility fragile - one pride parade in 2021

- Police assault of trans people - documented
- Medical denial on gender-expression grounds - documented
- Forced stripping, forced medical exams on arrest - documented
- Photos distributed on social media - documented
- Official calls for violence/death - documented
- Community violence (threats of burning alive) - documented

- Gender expression mismatch with documents is documented as a trigger- Police target gender-nonconforming people- Community hostility to visibility
- But no specific border/entry document screening documented

- Level 5: State or honor killing; death penalty applied; torture in custody; lethal violence with impunity

- Denial of medical care (level 4)
- Community violence with threats of death (level 4)
- Official incitement to violence (level 4-5)
